svg.title: Fourteen decade glyphs: mean plus observed monthly minimum and maximum; common −1.0 to +1.5°C position scale.

g.text: Anomaly (°C) relative to 1951–1980 · each decade contains 120 months
Liquid top + color: decade mean | Bracket: lowest to highest month
Read left to right, then continue on the next row. Ranges describe observed variation.
